blocks.text: DUBAI — A ship on fire has been reported in the Strait of Hormuz, British maritime agency UKMTO said on Thursday, without providing details of the cause of the blaze or any casualties. The agency said it received the report from the master of another ship, with the vessel spotted nine nautical miles (17 kilometres) north of Oman’s Khasab, which sits just off the strait. The Strait of Hormuz is a key transit point for global oil and natural gas supplies.
